'''FloatVans''' were a type of large [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]]. They were used by the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] around [[43 ABY]]. In this year, a FloatVan was used to evacuate four [[Force psychosis|psychotic]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] from the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in order to escape prosecution by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].
